title: Slovakian Dumplings with Wild Garlic
description: A hearty and flavorful Slovakian dish featuring wild garlic and homemade dumplings. Perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Combine the flour and water to form the dumpling dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place the dumpling circles in the boiling water and cook for 5-7 minutes.
While the dumplings are cooking, melt the butter in a pan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped wild garlic leaves and cook for an additional minute.
Once the dumplings are cooked, remove them from the water with a slotted spoon and add them to the pan with the garlic and wild garlic.
Stir in the chopped lovely leaves and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the dumplings hot with the garlic and wild garlic sauce spooned over the top.
